$comment: Tile-extraction bounding boxes ONLY. This is not circuit seed data.
Nothing here asserts anything about a venue beyond 'download OSM map tiles
covering this rectangle'. Circuit presets (name, timezone, layout variants,
centre) and marshal-post numbering are reserved for human sourcing from
official documents under spec §0.2 and do not belong in this file.

To add a venue: draw a rectangle at bboxfinder.com, paste the four numbers,
then run `npm run tiles -- <key>`. Verify the result by opening the map and
checking the whole circuit is inside the extract — a bbox that clips the far
side of the track looks fine until you walk there.

nordschleife.label: Nürburgring Nordschleife + GP-Strecke
nordschleife._note: Wider than the circuit on purpose. The camera is bounded to this rectangle, so it must be roomy enough to frame the whole lap with padding at any screen aspect — a bbox that merely contains the track leaves the camera unable to zoom out far enough to show it, clipping Hohe Acht off the top.

le-mans.label: Circuit de la Sarthe
le-mans._note: Full 24h layout. The bbox reaches well south-east for the Mulsanne straight and Arnage, and is deliberately far wider than the circuit: la Sarthe is a tall, narrow shape, so a snug bbox leaves the camera unable to zoom out enough to frame the lap on a wide screen.
